snippet.title: Alien Shooter - Full Gameplay [PC][1080p]
snippet.description:
Your mission is simple: clear the base at all costs. You will be provided with explosives to help you gain access to the teleports from where thousands of pitiless creatures pour.


https://store.steampowered.com/app/33100/Alien_Shooter/
